text:
maya: Heads-up: we'll try a controlled canary for v6-hybrid-q4 tomorrow 08:45 PT. This is the hybrid-int4 + small FP16-reserve build. Cost win expected, but worried about rerank drift and short-answer fidelity. Thoughts on gate definitions?
jon: Thumbs up. We should define both slice-level and global checks. Minimum: rerank_nDCG, short_answer_factual, latency_p99, token_fidelity, KL_calibration. Also capture sample traces for any slice alerts.
sophia: From bench: rerank_nDCG +0.5, short_answer_factual -0.6%, latency_p99 +10ms. Token_fidelity measured via edit-distance regressions ~0.3% worse on long-doc prefixes. Suggest strict short-answer thresholds.
lee: Proposal: two-tier gate: soft (observe) and hard (auto-fallback). Soft at 0.5% traffic for 40m: require rerank CI lower bound > 0 (bootstrap CI), short_answer_delta > -0.4% (i.e., no worse than 0.4%), p<0.05 for rerank uplift. If soft passes -> ramp to 5% shadow/promote. Hard gate: if any critical slice delta breaches abs 0.6% AND z>3 over rolling 10m window -> immediate cascade.
arjun: Cascade behavior: first route failing slice to sibling-int8 for affected requests, if slice still bad after grace_period 12m -> full rollback to v5-stable. Config example: `cascade=["sibling-int8","v5-stable"], grace_period=12m, min_samples=2500`.
jon: Add warmup mute: ignore gating for first 25m to avoid KV-cache JIT and kernel warmups. Instead collect warmup metrics and require `min_effective_samples=2000` per slice before gating triggers.
sophia: For noisy signals use rolling z-score + median bootstrap. I want to see both: (1) z>3 AND delta threshold, OR (2) bootstrap lower bound below negative threshold. That reduces single-stat false positives.
lee: Also watch calibration: KL_calibration > 0.08 on any slice -> flag. If KL spike + entropy drop >6% -> immediate partial reroute (20% of candidate traffic for that slice) for triage.
maya: Nice. Let's add synthetic probe-suite: 100 adversarial QA + 50 long-doc seeds every 7m; run both candidate and baseline and compute paired diffs. If probe-suite fails short_answer_delta > 0.5% -> immediate fallback.
arjun: I'll add a mini-activation dump hook for 1% of flagged requests (anonymized). We'll need ops sign-off for size, but helpful for sparse attention inspection.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: v6-hybrid-q4 -> 0.5% at 2026-04-14T15:45:00Z (canary id: canary-5101234567).
jon: Alerts I'll wire: `rerank_nDCG_bootstrap_lb`, `short_answer_delta_abs`, `latency_p99_ratio`, `kl_calibration`, `entropy_pct_drop`, `token_fidelity_edit`. Composite unhealthy rule: ((short_answer_delta < -0.6% AND z>3) OR (rerank_bootstrap_lb < 0 AND |delta|>0.4%)) AND samples >= min_samples -> mark unhealthy.
maya: For sequencing: staging -> 0.5% observe (soft) w/ shadowing to baseline -> 5% shadow/promote gating -> gradual ramp. Exclude warmup 25m window; require min_effective_samples. Also notify eng-oncall at promote start.
lee: Implementation note: slice routing requires fast-path tag in request headers; we'll add `x-rl-slice` header to trace routed requests.
sophia: Post-deploy: run a 90m sustained check for sustained MRR uplift (>0.35%) with p<0.05 before promoting beyond 10%. Also ensure latency_p99 stays <= 1.15x baseline.
deploy-bot: Canary started: v6-hybrid-q4 @0.5% traffic at 2026-04-14T15:45:12Z.
deploy-bot: Alert: short_answer_delta -0.72% (z=3.2) on probe-suite at 2026-04-14T16:09:20Z. Initiating targeted reroute: 0.4% traffic -> sibling-int8 at 2026-04-14T16:09:45Z.
maya: Dropping candidate global to 0.2% and kicking off rapid debug run with reduced quant sparsity. Will re-run probe-suite in 30m.
jon: Good. I'll capture paired diffs and open a temporary investigation board. Also throttling notes: ensure alert noise suppression so we don't cascade multiple fallbacks.
arjun: I'll enable activation dumps for those flagged requests and snapshot config used.
sophia: Schedule: if tuning doesn't improve after two quick cycles, we'll open a postmortem and revert rollout plan.
maya: Thanks team. Action items: jon -> dashboards/alerts; arjun -> activation hook; lee -> implement slice-routing headers + cascade config; sophia -> probe-suite orchestration; maya -> coordinate canary and oncall notify. :thumbsup:
